question: How far is the surface our DoD runs on from the surface the 2008 control actually measured?

inputs.role: gen1's own 2008 control; dnr_surface_z_m is the vendor's DELIVERED surface elevation at the mark
flight-line tracks, to find the site's own-line marks
DoD at elbaext; gen1's grid is recovered as z_after - this
DoD at elba_fulldensity; gen1's grid is recovered as z_after - this

params.name: dod_name
params.why: which DoD product recovers gen1 at each site; verified on elba_fulldensity against an independent gen1 grid to median +0.489 mm, NMAD 0.391 mm over 341,239 cells

params.name: window_cells
params.why: side of the square whose median is reported BESIDE the containing cell; a single 5 m cell is one noisy sample. Both are printed and neither is called the answer

columns.cover: MnDNR land-cover class of the mark, unitless code: L1O open, L2T tall weeds/crops, L3B brush, L4F forest, L5U urban
columns.gap: A = estimator gap (our reduction of the DELIVERED cloud vs the vendor's Surface Z). B = processing gap (our gridded CSF/aligned/geoid-shifted surface vs the vendor's Surface Z)
columns.delivered_z_m: the vendor's own dnr_surface_z_m at the mark
columns.ours_z_m: our surface at the mark: cloud reduction for A, grid for B
columns.geoid_mm: geoid conversion applied to gen1 at this mark to carry it onto gen2's GEOID18 frame, mm (references.geoid_difference); 0 for gap A, which is entirely within GEOID03
columns.bridge_raw_mm: z_delivered - z_ours, mm, WITHOUT undoing the geoid conversion; for gap B this differences two geoids and is reported only so the conversion's size is visible
columns.bridge_mm: z_delivered - z_ours with both on NAVD88(GEOID03), mm; ADD to a delivered-surface constant to carry it onto our surface

notes: A and B are DIFFERENT quantities. A is not a proxy for B: it changes only the reduction, while B also changes the ground classification, the swath alignment and the vertical datum.
Gap B's raw value differences NAVD88(GEOID03) control against a GEOID18-framed surface. The geoid column undoes that; read bridge_mm, not bridge_raw_mm.
headline: A n=11 mean -6.59 mm; B n=2
